descriptions: Added an open minigame file, src/minigames/minigames.lua — every crime starts its minigame from there (lockpick, ATM hack, pickpocketing, vending machine skill check). Swap in any minigame script, for all crimes or just one. How-to and examples are in config.lua.

Added a 'Carry Prop' tab to the Parcels editor to change the prop you hold after stealing a parcel: model, bone, position, rotation and carry animation. Use 'Preview on me' to see it on your character before saving, and 'Reset' to go back to the default box.
Fixed some players not seeing parcels: parcels that came back from cooldown after a player joined now show up for them too.
Fixed one prop failing to load hiding every parcel for that player.
Qbox: players online during a script restart now get parcels (and Smash N Grab) without relogging.
Props are now properly loaded before they spawn (parcels and Smash N Grab loot), so they're less likely to go missing on busy servers.
With Config.Debug on, F8 now tells you when a parcel prop can't be spawned.
When updating: add the new src/minigames/ folder and replace the fxmanifest, which has changed.
Restart the resource; your editor settings carry over and the carry prop starts as the default box.
